data.one_liner: Ready-to-use Flutter widgets powered by GLSL fragment shaders.
data.what_it_does: Provides GPU-accelerated UI effects, backgrounds, and loading skeletons using GLSL fragment shaders. Includes widgets like animated gradient borders, frosted surfaces, and water or fire effects with zero external dependencies.
use_when: You want GPU-accelerated visual effects like aurora, fire, or glassmorphism in your app.
You need ready-to-use shader components such as frosted surfaces or animated gradient borders.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms that do not support Flutter fragment shaders or have issues with Impeller/Skia shader compilation.
Your application requires basic, lightweight UI elements without custom graphical effects.
strengths: Zero external dependencies outside of the Flutter SDK.
Includes built-in frame-rate capping and reduced-motion support.
Provides a global shader cache and performance management utilities.
weaknesses: Relies on GLSL fragment shaders which may behave differently across various graphics backends (Skia and Impeller).
GPU-accelerated effects can impact battery life and performance if not properly capped.
data.setup_notes: Requires no additional native configuration beyond Flutter >= 3.10.0 and Dart >= 3.0.0.

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a lightweight, non-shader based shimmer effect for loading placeholders.

data.minimal_example:
WaveBackground(

)
